title: Graduate a channel post to Knowledge — the durable home for a reusable finding with no external tracker

epic.name: Coordination Bus v2 (re-scoped): Repo Coordination Bus

story.as_a: coding agent that produced a genuinely reusable finding on the channel with no external tracker to hold it
story.i_want_to: graduate that post into the durable Knowledge plane
story.so_that: a reusable lesson survives the channel's 30-day expiry — while a transient directive is left to expire, not force-graduated

rationale: Refocus of the old US-40.1. The panel narrowed it: graduate-to-Knowledge is NOT the general handoff-durability answer (a single-use handoff payload pollutes the wiki; the novelty gate rejects most, and handoff durability = an external artifact + pointer per invariant 1). It IS the right durable home for a CONTENT-APPROPRIATE case: a reusable finding with no external tracker. So this story is content-selective — a transient 'run this SQL' directive stays transient; a reusable finding graduates. It reuses Knowledge's existing guardrails (novelty gate + a separate secret scan), never a bypass, because it is the ONE path that moves channel content into the durable plane.

background.reference: panel 'US-40.1 graduate-to-Knowledge as the handoff durability answer -- WRONG' (keep it for genuine reusable lessons, NOT every handoff); re-scope invariant 1 + Group E (40.E1); Knowledge.propose_article/3 (knowledge.ex:423) vs create_article/3 (knowledge.ex:293); SecretDenylist (secret_denylist.ex); Coordination.get_post/2 (added by 40.D1).
background.includes: An agent-triggered one-call promotion from a channel post to a Knowledge article, through the SAME novelty + secret gates as knowledge_create, content-selective and rate-bounded. Refocuses docs/user_stories/epic_40_coordination_bus_v2/us_40.1.json.

acceptance_criteria.description: POST /api/v1/channel/posts/:id/graduate (agent role) fetches the post tenant-scoped via Coordination.get_post/2 (the public path added by 40.D1) and creates a Knowledge article from it (title required, body from the post body, project_id carried over, tags). The source post is then kept (the sweep reclaims it in 30d) or deleted via the author-only redact (40.D2) — it is NOT marked 'graduated' (no such column exists on channel_posts).

Graduation goes through the SEMANTIC NOVELTY gate via Loopctl.Knowledge.propose_article/3 (knowledge.ex:423), NOT create_article/3 (knowledge.ex:293): a near-duplicate returns {verdict: :duplicate, article: existing, created: false} and creates nothing (so a single-use/duplicate finding does NOT pollute the wiki — the panel's core objection). Because neither propose_article nor create_article runs a secret scan, the shared SecretDenylist (secret_denylist.ex) is ALSO run over the post body as an explicit step BEFORE propose_article — a secret cannot be smuggled into the durable plane via this path. Project/tenant ownership is enforced (and, per 40.D3, project membership).

The resulting article carries provenance attributable to the channel origin: a source_type + a source reference to the originating post/agent, attributed to the graduating agent. NOTE: article validate_source_type (article.ex:468-482) restricts source_type to @known_source_types (article.ex:38: review_finding manual agent session_log newsletter skill web_article ingestion) — 'channel_graduation' is NOT in that list and would be REJECTED. Resolve by either (a) adding 'channel_graduation' to @known_source_types (article.ex:38), or (b) reusing source_type 'agent' with a source_id/reference naming the post. Pick one and state it; do NOT set an unknown source_type that fails validation.

CONTENT-SELECTIVE, not graduate-every-handoff: the tool/docs make explicit this is for a REUSABLE finding, not routine handoffs. There is NO automatic graduation of handoffs; graduation is an explicit, deliberate agent call. Rate-bounded by the existing limiter (per-api_key + per-tenant buckets — no per-agent bucket) so it cannot bulk-flood Knowledge from the channel.

A channel_graduate(post_id, title, tags?) MCP tool is added (agent key) and shipped in the mcp-server publish, with a description stating it is for reusable findings (transient directives should be left to expire).

test_cases.name: graduate a reusable finding creates an attributed article
preconditions: tenant = fixture(:tenant); project = fixture(:project, %{tenant_id: tenant.id}); {key,_} = fixture(:api_key, %{tenant_id: tenant.id, role: :agent}); a channel post exists
expected_results: a knowledge article created with the post body + project_id; provenance references the post/agent; valid source_type (passes validate_source_type)

test_cases.name: near-duplicate graduation dedups (no wiki pollution)
preconditions: an existing article near-identical to the post
expected_results: {verdict: :duplicate}; returns the existing article id; no duplicate created

test_cases.name: secret in the post body blocks graduation
preconditions: a post whose body contains a token-shaped string

test_cases.name: cross-tenant post cannot be graduated
expected_results: 404; no article created (Coordination.get_post/2 tenant-scoped, no oracle)

test_cases.name: unknown source_type does not slip through
expected_results: source_type is in @known_source_types (article.ex:38) — no validate_source_type error

technical_notes: Graduate via Loopctl.Knowledge.propose_article/3 (knowledge.ex:423) — it wraps create_article with the novelty gate and returns {:ok, %{verdict: :duplicate, article, created: false}} on a near-dup. create_article/3 (knowledge.ex:293) does exact-idempotency dedup + ownership + length caps but NOT the novelty gate and NO secret scan.
Run SecretDenylist (secret_denylist.ex, contains_secret?/1) over the post body as an explicit step BEFORE propose_article — the create path won't.

Reuse Coordination.get_post/2 (public, tenant-scoped, UUID-guarded) added by 40.D1 — do NOT add a second by-id fetch (the old US-40.1 added its own get_post; now 40.D1 owns it). This is why E1 depends on D1.

source_type: RESOLVE the validate_source_type constraint (article.ex:468-482, @known_source_types :38). Recommend adding 'channel_graduation' to @known_source_types (one-line, explicit provenance) OR reuse 'agent' + source_id = the post id. The old US-40.1 said set source_type 'channel_graduation' — that would FAIL validation as written; this AC fixes that.
Post-graduation fate: keep (sweep reclaims in 30d) OR author-only delete via 40.D2 — NOT a 'graduated' flag (no column).
MCP: add channel_graduate alongside the other channel tools (mcp-server/index.js).
